name: Flexed-Arm Hang
steps: Take a shoulder-width overhand or underhand grip on a pull-up bar and step or jump up until your chin sits clearly above the bar.
Pull your shoulder blades down and back, keep your elbows tight, and brace your core with your legs steady.
Hold your chin above the bar steadily without letting your chin rest on top of the bar.
Lower yourself smoothly under control to straight arms once you complete the hold.
tips: Keep your shoulders packed down and chest proud rather than hunching your neck to keep your chin high.
Avoid kicking or swinging your legs while maintaining steady breathing during the hold.
